name: Future Forward

summary.text: Future Forward is a Democratic political operation made up of Future Forward USA PAC (FF PAC), a hybrid PAC/super PAC that files with the Federal Election Commission, and its parent, Future Forward USA Action, a 501(c)(4) nonprofit that is not required to disclose its donors and does not do so. The super PAC backed Joe Biden in 2020 and Biden and then Kamala Harris in 2024, concentrating on television and digital advertising selected through large-scale survey and ad testing. Its disclosed donors have included Dustin Moskovitz, Reid Hoffman, Michael Bloomberg and, in 2020, Sam Bankman-Fried and Alameda Research; a large share of its money arrives from the nonprofit arm, whose sources are not public.

facts.claim: Future Forward USA Action, the parent of FF PAC, is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit that can raise unlimited amounts without disclosing its donors; it is not legally required to disclose them and does not do so voluntarily.
facts.quote: As a 501(c)(4) nonprofit organization, Future Forward USA Action is not legally required to disclose its donors and does not voluntarily do so

facts.claim: In the 2020 cycle FF PAC spent $150.8 million and received more than $61 million from its parent, Future Forward USA Action. ABC News reported in October 2020 that the PAC had told the FEC it brought in $74 million from June 2019 through mid-October 2020 and was running a $100 million pro-Biden ad campaign partly funded by undisclosed donors.
facts.quote: In the 2020 election cycle, FF PAC received over $61 million in donations from its parent organization, Future Forward USA Action

facts.claim: FactCheck.org, citing FEC data, says the PAC's top individual donor in 2020 was Facebook co-founder Dustin Moskovitz, and that for the 2020 and 2022 cycles combined FF PAC raised $182 million, with more than $77 million coming from its parent organization.
facts.quote: for the 2020 presidential and 2022 midterm campaign cycles, FF PAC raised a combined $182 million, with more than $77 million coming from its parent organization

facts.claim: CNBC reported, citing FEC records, that Alameda Research gave about $5.24 million in 2020 to Future Forward USA, and that Sam Bankman-Fried separately donated $5 million to the super PAC that cycle. CBS News put the combined 2020 giving of Bankman-Fried and Nishad Singh to the PAC at $6 million.
facts.quote: Alameda gave about $5.24 million in 2020 to Future Forward USA, the super PAC that backed Biden's win

facts.claim: In January 2024 CNN reported that Future Forward planned a $250 million fall advertising campaign for Biden, reserving ad slots months ahead and choosing ads through a process of testing and refining; press accounts describe its data scientists surveying millions of voters and testing thousands of ads to find those that most moved voters. Reports in January 2024 said the group had raised $208 million for the cycle to that point.
facts.quote: relying on a process of testing and refining to decide which ads will reach likely voters in ad slots reserved months ahead of the key election season

facts.claim: The Campaign Legal Center reported during the 2024 cycle that FF PAC had raised nearly $400 million to that point. The Brennan Center reported that the affiliated nonprofit poured more than $304 million into ad spending and contributions to the super PAC in 2024, and the Wausau Pilot & Review, relaying New York Times reporting, said the ultimate source of over $136.4 million of the PAC's funds was unknown.

openQuestions: A single authoritative 2024-cycle fundraising total for FF PAC was not sourced: figures seen range from nearly $400 million (Campaign Legal Center, mid-cycle) to about $559 million in receipts (SuperPACs.com) and New York Times figures of over $950 million for PAC and nonprofit combined, relayed by InfluenceWatch and not opened. Check the committee's 2024 year-end report on FEC.gov.
The undisclosed-donor share could not be computed reliably: the $304 million (Brennan Center) and $136.4 million 'source unknown' (NYT via Wausau Pilot) figures use different bases.

Bankman-Fried's 2020 giving to the PAC is reported variously as $5 million (own name), $5.24 million (Alameda), $6 million (with Singh) and $10 million (InfluenceWatch, not used); FEC contribution records would settle it.
Hoffman's 2024 giving is $10 million per the Washington Examiner's FEC analysis and 'more than $10 million' per CNN; the two are consistent but the final total was not confirmed.
The ad-testing description is from press accounts; no statement from Future Forward itself describing its method was opened.
Bill Gates was reported (Wikipedia, not cited) to have given $50 million to Future Forward USA Action; not recorded for lack of a primary or major-outlet source in the search results.
